author: /root/oraculo_metodo_r2
objective: Medir exploratoriamente, em exatamente um par válido, o efeito incremental do Bateia como catalisador quando ambos os braços também pesquisam na internet.

execution_order.rule: Odd first hexadecimal nibble executes treatment first; even executes control first.

treatment.required_temporal_order: bateia_recommend must complete before the first native web_search starts

execution_limits.retry: No retry is available under the two-session hard cap.

monitoring.session_id: Persist before any yield and reuse until terminal.
monitoring.terminal_evidence: exit_code from the same process session

valid_pair.predicate: Both arms satisfy schema, output, terminal, capability, cardinality and ordering invariants and exactly two behavioral sessions were consumed.
valid_pair.success: Stop immediately after the one valid pair is recorded.
valid_pair.failure: Any invalid arm, duplicate, overlap, missing terminal exit_code, cap breach or infrastructure failure after agent_message stops without replacement.

phase_1_blind_output.inputs: Two schema-valid outputs under randomized opaque labels; arm identity and all tool traces hidden.
dimensions: decision-relevant findings with resolvable public support
novel supported alternatives, mechanisms or hypotheses
conciseness and decision utility independent of raw volume

phase_2_post_reveal_catalysis_audit.inputs: Frozen blind receipt, revealed arm mapping and ordered immutable tool trace.
phase_2_post_reveal_catalysis_audit.catalytic_path: A direction observable in bateia_recommend must precede and materially shape a later native web_search whose public evidence confirms, rejects or usefully narrows that direction and is reflected in a useful finding or decision.
phase_2_post_reveal_catalysis_audit.cost_normalization: Count native web calls, Bateia call and retrieval/assessment overhead; greater volume or cost alone is never advantage.

inconclusive_policy: INCONCLUSIVE from Bateia is a neutral safe abstention. It is neither automatic defeat nor success; it may participate in a catalytic path only when a later observable web search confirms, rejects or usefully narrows a direction and yields a useful supported finding.
live_web_policy: Live-web observations are time-indexed and need not be byte-identical. A material temporal drift is neither equality nor arm effect by default; preserve it as Unknown/confounding unless evidence resolves it.

winner_policy.treatment_uplift: Allowed only if the frozen blind comparison favors the treatment output and the post-reveal audit proves at least one catalytic path.
winner_policy.otherwise: Report the observed blind relation separately from no demonstrated catalysis, tie, Unknown or harm; do not force a winner.

unknown_policy: Unknown never becomes success, failure, tie or zero by default. Missing identity, terminality, trace linkage, temporal comparability, schema support or resolvable evidence blocks only the affected conclusion and preserves neutral abstention.
